summary: Short-range imaging-infrared air-to-air missile with jet-vane thrust vectoring, high off-boresight
guidance: imaging infrared homing (128 x 128 focal plane array), jet-vane thrust vectoring
motor: the AIM-9M's motor (Mk 36): 'the same rocket motor and warhead as the AIM-9M'

range_km.note: the Sidewinder family's range (the article's '0.6 to 22 mi', 'not verified in body'): the AIM-9X's own is classified

speed_mach.note: the family's 'Mach 2.5+': the AIM-9X's own is classified, its motor the AIM-9M's

power_up_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

power_down_s.note: no source gives a missile's power-up or power-down time: 1 s for every missile, an engineering assumption so a strike waits for its missiles as a real one does

explosive_kg.note: a game reference: War Thunder's us_aim9m_sidewinder (the AIM-9M's) (PBXN-3); no manufacturer or encyclopedia gives the charge

gurney_kms.note: PBXN-3 (86 % HMX in nylon) is not in Cooper's table: as Comp B (2.70) - an estimate

drag_area_m2.note: the isolated store's CD S below Mach 0.8 at a Reynolds number of 1e7 per metre, built up from its design (hangar storedrag.py: Hoerner's body of revolution 0.00231, its base 0.00055, its fins' friction 0.00106 m^2): an estimate by one method for every store

munk_volume_m3.note: its body's unstable moment across a flow, q x this x sin(2 x angle) (Munk, NACA Report 184): its volume 0.0369 m^3 from its design, times Lamb's k2 - k1 = 0.989 for its fineness 23.7 (hangar storedrag.py): an estimate by one method for every store

side_slope_m2.note: its fins' and base's force across it per radian of crossflow, over the dynamic pressure (hangar storedrag.py: one fin pair's Helmbold slope carried onto the body, slender-body theory's base): an estimate by one method for every store

side_arm_m.note: where that force acts, behind the store's CG (hangar storedrag.py: its fins' quarter chords, its base)

wt-datamine.title: War Thunder datamine: rocketguns weapon files (a game reference: the game's own values, not a manufacturer's)
